items.title: Sickle-cell disease.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of sickle cell disease pathophysiology, clinical management, and evidence-based treatments including the role of blood transfusion and hydroxycarbamide.

items.title: Sickle cell disease.
items.summary: Updated comprehensive seminar on sickle cell disease covering pathophysiology, acute manifestations, chronic complications, and recent advances including expanded hydroxyurea implementation.

items.title: Sickle Cell Disease: Monitoring, Current Treatment, and Therapeutics Under Development.
items.summary: Review of current standard of care for children with sickle cell disease including screening recommendations, disease monitoring, treatment approaches, and novel pharmacologic agents under investigation.

items.title: The vaso-occlusive pain crisis in sickle cell disease: Definition, pathophysiology, and management.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of vaso-occlusive crisis definition, pathophysiology, and management, including FDA-approved treatments hydroxyurea, L-glutamine, crizanlizumab, and voxelotor.

items.title: A review on disease modifying pharmacologic therapies for sickle cell disease.
items.summary: Review of disease-modifying pharmacologic therapies for sickle cell disease, discussing limitations of current treatments and slow progress toward novel therapeutic strategies.

items.title: Sickle Cell Disease: A Review.
items.summary: Comprehensive JAMA review of sickle cell disease covering diagnosis, pathophysiology, clinical manifestations, and current treatment approaches.

items.title: Crizanlizumab with or without hydroxyurea in patients with sickle cell disease (STAND): primary analyses from a placebo-controlled, randomised, double-blind, phase 3 trial.
items.summary: Phase 3 randomized controlled trial (STAND) evaluating efficacy and safety of two doses of crizanlizumab in sickle cell disease patients.

items.title: Effect of Poloxamer 188 vs Placebo on Painful Vaso-Occlusive Episodes in Children and Adults With Sickle Cell Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: Phase 3 randomized controlled trial showing poloxamer 188 failed to demonstrate efficacy for painful vaso-occlusive episodes in children and adults with sickle cell disease.

items.title: Sevuparin for the treatment of acute pain crisis in patients with sickle cell disease: a multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial.
items.summary: Phase 2 randomized controlled trial of sevuparin, a novel non-anticoagulant heparinoid, for treatment of acute pain crisis in hospitalized sickle cell disease patients.

items.title: Piracetam for reducing the incidence of painful sickle cell disease crises.
items.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
items.summary: Cochrane systematic review and meta-analysis assessing effectiveness of piracetam for reducing incidence of painful sickle cell disease crises.

items.title: Isoquercetin for thromboinflammation in sickle cell disease: a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial.
items.summary: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of isoquercetin for thromboinflammation in adults with steady-state sickle cell disease.

items.title: Folic acid supplementation in children with sickle cell disease: a randomized double-blind noninferiority cross-over trial.
items.journal: The American journal of clinical nutrition
items.summary: Randomized double-blind noninferiority crossover trial examining efficacy of folic acid supplementation in children with sickle cell disease.

items.title: Vitamin D supplementation for sickle cell disease.
items.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
items.summary: Cochrane systematic review evaluating vitamin D supplementation for sickle cell disease patients with multiple macro- and micro-nutrient deficits.

items.title: Zinc supplements for treating thalassaemia and sickle cell disease.
items.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
items.summary: Cochrane systematic review and meta-analysis of zinc supplements for treating thalassemia and sickle cell disease.

items.title: Mitapivat for sickle cell disease and thalassemia.
items.summary: Review of mitapivat, an oral pyruvate kinase activator being explored for sickle cell disease and thalassemia after initial approval for pyruvate kinase deficiency.

items.title: Cerebrovascular disease in sickle cell disease.
Neurologic Complications of Sickle Cell Disease.

redFlags: Acute chest syndrome requires immediate medical attention
Stroke in sickle cell disease patients requires urgent transfusion without delay
Pregnancy exacerbates sickle cell disease with increased maternal and fetal morbidity and mortality

excludedAgents.name: Poloxamer 188
excludedAgents.reason: Phase 3 randomized controlled trial failed to demonstrate efficacy for painful vaso-occlusive episodes in children and adults with sickle cell disease

excludedAgents.name: Piracetam
excludedAgents.reason: Cochrane systematic review and meta-analysis found insufficient evidence for effectiveness in reducing incidence of painful sickle cell disease crises

excludedAgents.name: Sevuparin
excludedAgents.reason: Phase 2 randomized controlled trial failed to demonstrate efficacy for shortening vaso-occlusive crisis duration in hospitalized patients
